observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== Ruby/Node versions ==="; /usr/local/ruby/bin/ruby --version; /opt/node/bin/node --version; echo; echo "=== bundle gem count ==="; export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:$PATH; bundle check 2>&1 | head -1; echo; echo "=== config files present ==="; ls -la config/database.yml config/secrets.yml config/secret_emails.yml 2>&1 | awk '{print $NF, $5"B"}'; echo; echo "=== force_ssl final ==="; grep -n "force_ssl" config/secrets.yml | tail -1; echo; echo "=== production db table count ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -t -c "select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public';"; echo "=== assets precompiled ==="; ls public/assets/ | grep -c ".-"
